highlights.reason_zh: Large 4 从 preview 变为权重可下载，直接改变自托管可行性；MaaS 许可与 1T 模型成本是关键限制。
highlights.reason_en: Large 4 moves from preview to downloadable weights, changing self-hosting feasibility; MaaS licensing and 1T-model cost are key constraints.

highlights.reason_zh: Carbon 显示网络安全模型能力继续上升，但只有受限预发布，外部团队无法复现或集成。
highlights.reason_en: Carbon signals stronger cyber capability, but restricted pre-release access prevents external reproduction or integration.

highlights.reason_zh: Copilot 云会话 GA 改变 coding agent 的状态、凭据与算力预算归属，11 月计费前需要实测。
highlights.reason_en: Copilot cloud-session GA changes where coding-agent state, credentials and compute budgets live, requiring tests before November billing.

highlights.reason_zh: Concordat 用公开代码把确认规则从 prompt 移到运行时协议，结果有工程价值但仍局限于单一场景。
highlights.reason_en: Concordat uses public code to move confirmation rules from prompts into runtime protocols; the result is actionable but single-domain.

highlights.reason_zh: 两个小团队 Swift 包补足 Apple 端侧语音与类型化决策工具链，同时明确暴露依赖冲突。
highlights.reason_en: Two small-team Swift packages fill Apple on-device speech and typed-decision gaps while clearly exposing a dependency conflict.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功并完成阅读，并补查官方博客、GitHub、Hugging Face、arXiv、中文与其他非英语线索及重大综合新闻。两项日期精度仅到日；两项定向补漏按 late discovery 处理。厂商 benchmark 与性能数据未独立复现。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were fully read, supplemented by official blogs, GitHub, Hugging Face, arXiv, Chinese and other non-English leads, and major general-news review. Two sources expose date-only precision; two targeted misses are recorded as late discoveries. Vendor benchmarks and performance claims are not independently reproduced.
